newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE ends flat, pulled off record high by Dow.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE ends flat, pulled off record high by Dow.

text.p: London's FTSE 100 share index ended barely changed on Thursday as a faltering Wall Street hauled it back from a new peak reached earlier in the session.
The FTSE finished down 1.3 points at 4,356.1 after having clambered to an all-time high of 4,362.4 in morning trade. The index spent the whole day within a 20-point trading range.

It was the third time this week that the FTSE has ended the day close to where it began -- it slipped 3.2 points on Monday and 5.5 on Tuesday. Dealers said this reflected uncertainty about whether markets can sustain their record levels. "Since the Dow hit 7,000 people have been a bit edgy," one said.
